revision: BodyV6.13 ECO r6 (updated: right screw slot, top-left corner trim, encoder MH2 Ø2.8, MK1 → MP34DT05TR-A on the B side, U6 → BQ24073RGTR, U7 → RT6150BGQW + FB divider) - populated fit model

inputs.component_models: 3d/main-populated-native.step and 3d/encoder-populated-native.step (KiCad 10.0.4 native exports of the updated r6 boards); C52/C53 DNP have no model
inputs.board_bodies: 1.0 mm nominal prisms rebuilt from Edge.Cuts with NPTH holes
inputs.main_board_current_note: the current board differs from the fitted one (main_board_sha256) only by silkscreen pin-1 dots, which are not in the STEP exports, so the fit results apply unchanged

frame: BodyV6.13.step coordinates: X = u - 28, Z = 47.5 - v, Y = board normal, F (battery/back) side toward -Y

board_pose.main: B face Y=9.275 (pillar seats), F face Y=8.275
board_pose.encoder: B face Y=3.5 (case post shoulder), F face Y=2.5; the back cover (whose bosses cap the encoder F side) is not in the V6.13 export

case_solid_naming: Fusion export is one part with 8 solids; names are interpretations by bounding box (Case, Wheel, 4 side buttons, 2 front buttons). The back cover of V6/V6.9 is not in this export.

intersections.interpretation: USB-C shell vs the case opening corners: 0.16 mm3, unchanged since r3

wheel hex shaft (1.905 across flats) inside the encoder hex bore (1.72 across flats per the Alps drawing), 0.62 mm3, unchanged since r3: not a usable fit; the wheel hex should be about 1.68 across flats (corrected 2026-09-24; earlier reports called this an intended press fit)

findings: No interference beyond the two long-standing intended/known ones (USB-C mouth corners; wheel hex shaft in the encoder bore, which needs the wheel hex reduced to about 1.68 across flats).

Board edge to case at the board plane: 0.125 mm at the TL/BR pillars and their corner webs (TL: only at the notch arc ends now that the two corner tips are removed), 0.23 left rib, 0.245 seat block, 0.30 right boss, 0.51 new right screw slot to the wall (see eco audit).
The updated outline (right screw U-slot, TL corner trim) changes no intersection, cross-board result or component clearance: re-run on the updated board gives the same numbers as the first r6 run.

MK1 is now the MP34DT05TR-A on the B side at (48, 70.5), inside the hollow sound post (bore r3.0 from the board face Y 9.28 to the front wall Y 14): 0.43 mm from the package model (3.1 x 4.1 x 1.1 maximum-size envelope) to the bore wall, no interference; the old SPM1423 on the F side had 1.01 mm. A line straight out of the sound port (48, 69.72) passes the Ø2.0 front hole 0.22 mm inside its edge. All other intersections and clearances are unchanged.

U6 is now the TI BQ24073RGTR (3.1 x 3.1 x 1.0 maximum-size envelope) at the old U6 centre (15, 10) on the F side, with R37/R38/C40/C41/C48 re-placed around it and C51/R33 removed. None of these parts comes within 1.5 mm of a case solid, and U6 is outside the battery reserve (v 23.7-44.3). Intersections, cross-board results and every reported clearance are identical to the run before the swap.

U7 is now the adjustable RT6150BGQW (same package and place as before) with its FB divider R42/R43 on the B side under U7. The two new 0402s are not within 1.5 mm of any case solid; intersections, cross-board results and every reported clearance are identical to the run before the change.

Encoder MH2 enlarged to Ø2.8 around the Ø2.55 case spigot (0.125 mm radial at the board plane, was 0.025); re-run gives the same intersections and clearances (the encoder board still touches the case at the MH1 seat block and MH2 shoulder, as intended).
Component clearances unchanged from r5: R39 0.25, Y1 0.54, C11 0.43, R7 0.54 mm; side switches 0.06 mm to the side buttons; SW3/SW4 0.89 mm to the front-button caps.
Encoder board touches the wheel hub underside (0 mm), as in r4/r5.
Back-cover checks (ENC1 through the cover, encoder MH2 spigot/boss) cannot be run: no cover in this export.
limitations: Static nominal assembly; no button travel, no display module, no battery, no cable, no fasteners (the new right M2 screw is not modelled; its head-to-rib check is in the eco audit), no back cover.
Component geometry is the release model set (vendor CAD where registered, otherwise labelled envelopes).
Boolean interference threshold 1e-4 mm3; clearances reported only below 1.5 mm.

outputs.3d/main-populated-bodyv6.13.step: main board + 120 fitted components in the BodyV6.13 frame (MK1 = MP34DT05TR-A on the B side, U6 = BQ24073RGTR, U7 = RT6150BGQW with R42/R43)
outputs.3d/encoder-populated-bodyv6.13.step: encoder board + ENC1 + J1 in the same frame
outputs.3d/bodyv6.13-fit-assembly.step: BodyV6.13 case solids + both populated boards

encoder_wheel_variant_note: An alternative encoder board with ENC1 on the wheel side (encoder-wheel/) has its own fit check: encoder-wheel/verification/encoder-wheel-fit-report.json and 3d/bodyv6.13-encoder-wheel-fit-assembly.step.
